mission_09: Outstanding achievement! You have implemented FGSM, a foundational adversarial attack that doubles as a powerful data augmentation technique. By computing gradients with respect to the input and perturbing in the direction of maximum loss increase, FGSM creates challenging adversarial examples that expose model vulnerabilities. Training on these examples makes models more robust and generalizable. The elegance of FGSM lies in its simplicity: a single backward pass generates effective adversarial perturbations. This technique has spawned an entire field of adversarial machine learning and remains a standard tool for both attacking and defending deep learning models. Your implementation demonstrates the critical intersection of optimization theory and practical model robustness.
